purpose: One controlled boot attempt using the original slot A
proposed_operations: Recheck one connected GoColor7_2, fastbootd, current B, no pending snapshot merge.
Set original slot A active (fastboot set_active a). This writes boot-control metadata, clearing its unbootable state and resetting retry/success flags as implemented by BOOX boot HAL.
Re-query current slot and A bootability. Stop on failure or unexpected values.
Observe Android connection and original model/build/slot/startup completion for up to 180 seconds; stop rather than repeating if it loops.
limits: Root cause of A becoming unbootable is unknown.
Current contents of A are not yet independently reread after the failure.
Switching slots can fail if its firmware has a separate fault; normal boot is not guaranteed.
why_approval_needed: The user authorized read-only backup. This recovery action changes persistent boot selection metadata.
